avoid.reason: Very safe; pickpocketing at the Hauptbahnhof and during Oktoberfest

hood_desc: Altstadt is Munich's historic old town centered on Marienplatz, packed with landmarks, beer halls and the Viktualienmarkt, ideal for first-time visitors and sightseers.
Schwabing is the elegant former artists' quarter beside the English Garden, full of cafes, boutiques and leafy streets, suited to relaxed and upmarket travelers.
Maxvorstadt is the university and museum district holding the Pinakothek galleries, with student cafes and a cultured, intellectual vibe, great for art lovers.
Haidhausen is a charming, village-like neighborhood of cobbled squares, wine bars and the Gasteig arts center, appealing to families and calmer stays.
Glockenbachviertel is Munich's trendy nightlife and LGBTQ+ district with stylish bars, design shops and riverside walks, perfect for a lively social scene.

water.note: Tap water is high quality and safe to drink straight from the tap.

transit.pay: No transit card needed: buy tickets in the MVGO or MVV app or from station machines (bank cards accepted) and validate before boarding. A zone M single is about 4 EUR (~US$4.50) and a day ticket about 10 EUR; one ticket covers U-Bahn, S-Bahn, trams and buses. The airport-city day ticket is good value for arrivals.
transit.hours: U-Bahn and S-Bahn run about 4am-1am (until ~2am on weekends); night trams and buses cover the small hours.

transit.m: S-Bahn S1 or S8 to Marienplatz (40 min)
Lufthansa Express Bus to Hauptbahnhof (45 min)

food.name: Weissbier

places.name: Weisses Brauhaus

places.name: Paulaner am Nockherberg

landmarks: Marienplatz
Munich's central square, dominated by the Neo-Gothic New Town Hall and its glockenspiel, is the postcard image of the city.
Frauenkirche (Munich Cathedral)
The twin onion-domed towers of this Gothic brick cathedral form the defining silhouette of the Munich skyline.
Nymphenburg Palace
A grand Baroque summer palace with vast formal gardens, once home to Bavarian royalty and a favorite for elegant photography.
Englischer Garten (English Garden)
One of the world's largest urban parks, famous for its surfers on the Eisbach wave, beer gardens, and the Chinese Tower pagoda.
Viktualienmarkt
A lively year-round market square with a maypole and beer garden, capturing the flavor of everyday Bavarian life.
Olympiapark
The striking tent-roofed venues from the 1972 Olympics, anchored by the Olympic Tower, offer a modern architectural counterpoint to old Munich.
Munich Residenz
The former royal palace of the Wittelsbach dynasty is one of Europe's most opulent palace-museums, packed with lavish state rooms.
Hofbräuhaus am Platzl
The world-famous 16th-century beer hall is a symbol of Bavarian beer culture and one of Munich's most visited attractions.
BMW Museum / BMW Welt
The futuristic bowl-shaped museum and adjoining showroom celebrate Munich's automotive heritage with striking modern architecture.
Deutsches Museum
The world's largest science and technology museum, spread across an island in the Isar River with exhibits ranging from submarines to airplanes.

train.note: Everything leaves from Munich Hauptbahnhof, which is being rebuilt around the running railway, so allow extra time to find your platform. The overnight services are OeBB Nightjet sleepers - the Rome/Florence and Venice trains run daily, while the Amsterdam and Brussels sleepers run on selected days, so check dates. Amsterdam is also reachable by daytime ICE (~7h), and Salzburg is only 1h30 on the Railjet.

intl.to: Vienna, Prague, Zurich, Milan & across Europe

bus.note: International coaches use the ZOB central bus station at Hackerbrucke, one S-Bahn stop west of the Hauptbahnhof, a proper indoor terminal with shops and a ticket desk. Booking online is cheaper than at the counter. Prague takes about 5h30, Vienna 5h and Zurich 4h30.

ferry.note: Munich is landlocked, so there are no ferries. Local pleasure boats run on the nearby lakes (Starnberger See, Ammersee) in summer.

half.name: Dachau Memorial

full.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
full.blurb: The fairytale hilltop castle that inspired Disney, set against dramatic Alpine foothills and lakes.

full.name: Zugspitze
full.blurb: Germany's highest peak, reached by cog railway and cable car for sweeping Alpine panoramas.

full.name: Konigssee
full.blurb: An emerald glacial lake ringed by soaring cliffs, explored by silent electric boats.
